ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION

Silence, perfected.

Two times stronger cancellation removes twice as much background noise. The world goes quiet — your music doesn't have to shout.

PERSONALIZED SPATIAL AUDIO

Sound that moves with you.

Dynamic head tracking places sound all around you, tuned to the shape of your ears. Turn your head — the stage stays put.

MAGSAFE CHARGING CASE

Power, on tap.

Up to 6 hours on a charge, 30 with the case. Drop it on any MagSafe charger and keep going. Watch closely —

DESIGNED FOR EARS

Every detail, engineered.

Four pairs of silicone tips. Vent systems that equalize pressure. A fit so natural, you'll forget they're there.

Why you'll love them.

Keep scrolling — sideways this time.

01

H2. The force behind the quiet.

Apple's custom H2 chip runs the show — driving smarter noise cancellation, richer bass and clearer highs, all while sipping power.

02

Adaptive Transparency.

Hear the world when you want to. Intense sounds — sirens, construction — are softened in real time, 48,000 times a second.

03

Touch control.

Swipe up or down to nudge the volume. Press to play, pause, or switch modes. The stem is the remote.

04

MagSafe, meet USB-C.

Charge wirelessly on MagSafe, or plug in USB-C. A speaker on the case pings when it's lost. Precision Finding leads you right to it.

Small buds. Serious stamina.
